body:
INSTAGRAM
The fastest stack is the one you don't have to learn. Here's the boring one I ship every side project on.

Frontend: Next.js + TypeScript. Huge ecosystem, AI writes it well, types catch its mistakes early.
Backend: Supabase. Postgres, auth, storage and row-level security from day one, pgvector when you want AI features.
Shipping: Vercel for a preview URL on every change, Sentry for errors, PostHog for what people actually use.
Claude as the pair programmer.

Next.js: https://nextjs.org
TypeScript: https://www.typescriptlang.org
Supabase: https://supabase.com
Vercel: https://vercel.com
Sentry: https://sentry.io
PostHog: https://posthog.com
Claude: https://claude.ai
Comment STACK and I'll send you my side project stack, with links.
